priorStatuses.title: Parse the cached payload instead of the wrapper

findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant scoping in document lookup
findings.body: Querying only by `documentId` removes the authenticated tenant constraint. A request can therefore retrieve a document belonging to another tenant when its ID is known or collides, causing cross-tenant data exposure. Pass `ctx.tenantId` through and retain `{ tenantId, documentId }` in the query.
